common.tagline: Your AI companion for landing the next job
common.demoBanner: Demo mode: AI responses are simulated. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart to use Claude.
common.budgetWarning: AI spend today is {today} of your {cap} daily cap.
common.budgetExceeded: Daily AI budget reached ({cap}). Background work is paused until tomorrow or until you raise the cap in Settings.

dashboard.title: Welcome to Huntloop
dashboard.subtitle: Find the jobs where you have the best chance of getting an interview, then go after them together with your AI companion.
dashboard.stepKeyTodo: Add your Anthropic API key to .env.local. Until then everything runs in demo mode.
dashboard.stepModelsBody: Every task uses {model} by default. You can change models and effort per task in Settings.
dashboard.stepProfileBody: Upload your CV and tell Huntloop where you can work, so it can judge your chances for each job.
dashboard.stepJobBody: Paste a job link or the posting text, or drop in screenshots. Huntloop works out your chance of an interview.
dashboard.stepJobDone: {count, plural, one {# job added} other {# jobs added}}
dashboard.bestBetsDescription: Jobs you haven't applied to yet, with your strongest Interview Chance first.
dashboard.bestBetsEmpty: No jobs yet. Add one to see your chances.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, AI models and spending limits.
settings.languageDescription: Language of the app. The AI replies in the language you write to it.
settings.modelsDescription: Pick the default Claude model and, if you like, a different model or effort level for individual tasks. Higher effort means more careful answers, more time and higher cost.
settings.accessUnavailable: Not available for this API key
settings.accessDemo: Demo mode: all models appear available.
settings.accessError: Could not reach the Anthropic API: {message}
settings.budgetDescription: Background work (bulk analysis, searches, research) pauses when a cap is reached. Chats keep working but show a warning.
settings.monthlyCapHint: Leave empty for no monthly cap.
settings.keysDescription: Keys are read from .env.local in the project folder and never stored in the database. Restart the app after changing them.

extractProfile.name: Read your CV
extractProfile.description: Turns your CV into a structured profile (runs once per CV).

transcribePosting.name: Read screenshots
transcribePosting.description: Transcribes job posting screenshots and PDFs.

analyzePosting.name: Analyze postings
analyzePosting.description: Breaks a job posting into requirements, location and work-rights rules.

assess.name: Interview chance
assess.description: Checks each requirement against your profile, with evidence.

screen.name: Quick screening
screen.description: First pass over many search results.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Conversations about a job or your search.

searchAgent.name: Search agent
searchAgent.description: Finds postings on the web and job sites.

companyResearch.name: Employer research
companyResearch.description: Researches what a company does, how it is growing and who it hires.

planTailoring.name: CV tailoring plan
planTailoring.description: Plans how to tailor your CV for a job.

parseSearch.name: Understand search requests
parseSearch.description: Turns a search request into filters.

translate.name: Translate
translate.description: Translates AI explanations when you switch language.

errors.unsupported_file: That file type isn't supported. Upload a PDF, Word (.docx) or text file.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.cv_too_short: That doesn't look like a full CV yet — please paste the whole thing.
errors.missing_input: Choose a file or paste your CV first.
errors.refusal: Claude declined this request. Try again or rephrase it.
errors.budget: Your AI spending cap has been reached. Raise it in Settings to continue.
errors.invalid_output: The AI answer came back in an unexpected format. Please try again.
errors.max_tokens: The AI answer was too long. Please try again.
errors.missing_posting: Paste a job link or the posting text, or add screenshots first.
errors.posting_too_short: That's too short to be a job posting — paste the whole ad, or add screenshots.
errors.invalid_url: That link doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
errors.too_many_files: Add up to 12 files per job.
errors.unsupported_posting_file: Use screenshots (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) or a PDF.
errors.url_blocked: Huntloop doesn't open links to local or private network addresses.
errors.not_a_job_posting: This doesn't look like a job posting. Check the text or screenshots and try again.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Huntloop compares every job against this profile. Only facts here count as evidence.

upload.title: Start with your CV
upload.description: Huntloop reads your CV once and turns it into a structured profile you can edit. Your confirmed work rights and facts are kept when you replace it.
upload.fileHint: PDF, Word (.docx) or plain text, up to 10 MB.
upload.pastePlaceholder: Paste the full text of your CV here
upload.privacy: Your CV is stored on this computer and sent only to the Claude API to be read.
upload.stageAnalyzing: Claude is reading your CV. This usually takes under a minute.
upload.done: Done — your profile is ready below.

profile.name: Name
profile.headline: Headline
profile.workRightsDescription: Whether you can work in a country without sponsorship decides many applications before anyone reads your CV. Huntloop uses this to flag jobs you can't be hired for.
profile.experienceYears: {years} years in total (overlapping roles counted once)
profile.highlightsHint: One per line, as on your CV.
profile.dateError: Check the start and end dates of your roles (YYYY-MM or YYYY).
profile.skillsDescription: Everything you can be assessed on. Add skills you have even if your CV doesn't mention them yet.
profile.clearancesDescription: Some government and defence roles require one.
profile.factsDescription: True things that aren't on your CV (e.g. "Used Kafka in production at Acme"). Huntloop can use them as evidence and will suggest adding them to your CV.
profile.newFactPlaceholder: e.g. Led a team of 4 engineers for 1 year
profile.cvTextDescription: The exact text Huntloop quotes as evidence. Fix anything that was read incorrectly.

preferences.rolesDescription: Used to search and to focus the AI on what matters to you.
preferences.marketsDescription: Add every country you'd consider. Huntloop adapts to each market's conventions; jobs elsewhere are still analysed in their own country's context.
preferences.citiesHint: Leave empty for anywhere in the country.
preferences.salaryFloorHint: Optional. Used to filter, not to judge your chances.
preferences.excludedCompaniesHint: Jobs from these companies are hidden.
preferences.maxPostingAgeHint: Older postings are less likely to lead to an interview.
preferences.notesHint: Deal-breakers, wishes, context — the AI reads this.

workRights.au_482: Skills in Demand / TSS visa (482) — needs a new sponsor
workRights.nz_aewv: Accredited Employer Work Visa — needs a new employer
workRights.sg_dependant_loc: Dependant's Pass with Letter of Consent
workRights.sg_needs_pass: I'd need an Employment Pass or S Pass
workRights.us_h1b: H-1B — needs a transfer or new petition

addJob.label: Job link or posting text
addJob.placeholder: Paste a job link, or the full posting text. You can also drop or paste screenshots (Ctrl/⌘+V) or a PDF here.
addJob.contentPlaceholder: Paste the full posting text here, or drop or paste screenshots of the posting.
addJob.hint: Screenshots can be several parts of one long posting — add them in order. Your files stay on this computer and are only sent to Claude for reading.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Every job you've added, ranked by your chance of getting an interview.
jobs.addDescription: A link, the posting text, screenshots or a PDF — whatever you have.
jobs.hiddenIneligible: {count, plural, one {# job you're not eligible for is hidden.} other {# jobs you're not eligible for are hidden.}}

job.deleteConfirm: Delete this job and its analysis?
job.alreadyAdded: You've already added this job, so here it is.
job.possibleDuplicate: This looks like a job you've already added:
job.processingDescription: Huntloop is reading the posting, analysing its requirements and comparing them with your profile. You can leave this page; it keeps going.

needsContent.site_browser: Huntloop can't open {site} pages by itself yet. Paste the posting text or add screenshots of it.
needsContent.site_paste: {site} doesn't allow apps to read its pages. Paste the posting text or add screenshots of it.
needsContent.challenge: The site asked for a human check, so Huntloop couldn't read it. Paste the posting text or add screenshots.
needsContent.shell: That page loads its content with scripts Huntloop can't run. Paste the posting text or add screenshots.
needsContent.fetch_failed: Huntloop couldn't open that link. Paste the posting text or add screenshots.

job.needsProfile: Add your CV to see your Interview Chance for this job.
job.notAssessed: This job hasn't been compared with your profile yet.
job.profileChanged: Your CV, skills or facts changed since this assessment. Update it to include them.
job.attachmentsDescription: What you added. Open one to see it full size.
job.postingTextDescription: The text Huntloop analysed. Requirement quotes are checked against it.
job.postingTextFromImages: Read from your screenshots. If something was misread, correct it here and Huntloop will analyse it again.
job.editTextHint: Saving runs the analysis again with your text.

fit.tierExplainer: Tiers compare your profile with what this employer asks for. They're a guide to where to spend your effort, not a probability.

adjustment.fresh: Posted in the last few days {points}

cap.unmet_must: One must-have isn't met, so the tier is at most {tier}.
cap.two_unmet_musts: Two or more must-haves aren't met, so the tier is at most {tier}.
cap.years_short: You're more than two years short of the experience asked for, so the tier is at most {tier}.
cap.seniority_gap: The level is two or more steps from yours, so the tier is at most {tier}.

fit.gatesDescription: Hard requirements that decide whether your application can be considered at all.

gateReason.country_unknown: The posting doesn't say which country the job is in.
gateReason.work_rights_unknown: Your work rights in {country} aren't in your profile yet.
gateReason.pr_ok: You're a citizen or permanent resident of {country}.
gateReason.pr_required: Only citizens or permanent residents of {country} can apply.
gateReason.sponsorship_needed: You'd need visa sponsorship, and this employer doesn't offer it.
gateReason.restricted_visa: Your visa in {country} has conditions — check they allow this job.
gateReason.rights_ok: You have the right to work in {country}.
gateReason.sponsorship_unstated: You'd need sponsorship; the posting doesn't say whether it's offered.
gateReason.clearance_held: You hold the clearance this job needs.
gateReason.clearance_obtainable: You don't hold this clearance yet; check you can obtain it.
gateReason.clearance_needs_citizenship: This clearance is normally only granted to citizens of {country}.
gateReason.license_pass: You have the licence or registration needed.
gateReason.license_fail: You don't have the licence or registration needed.
gateReason.license_unclear: Your profile doesn't show this licence or registration.
gateReason.language_pass: You have the language skills needed.
gateReason.language_fail: You don't have the language skills needed.
gateReason.language_unclear: Your profile doesn't show this language level.
gateReason.outside_markets: {country} isn't one of your job-search countries, and you haven't said you'd relocate.
gateReason.stale: Posted {days} days ago — it has probably been filled.
gateReason.aging: Posted {days} days ago — check it's still open before applying.

fit.workRightsQuestion: Do you have work rights in {country}?
fit.workRightsHint: Saved to your profile and used for every job in this country.
fit.requirementsDescription: {count, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} found in the posting. Evidence is quoted from your CV and checked word for word.
fit.droppedEvidence: {count, plural, one {# quote couldn't be found in your CV and was ignored.} other {# quotes couldn't be found in your CV and were ignored.}}
fit.droppedRequirements: {count, plural, one {# requirement was} other {# requirements were}} left out because the quote couldn't be found in the posting.

gapHint.not_on_cv: You may have these — say so on your CV if you do.
gapHint.transferable: Related experience you can frame to cover these.

fit.changeDescription: Meeting (or showing on your CV) one of these would move you up a tier.
fit.translateFailed: The report couldn't be translated right now; showing the original.
